mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment, as indicated by FEDFUNDS below 2.0%, reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production above 105 and housing starts above 1300 indicates robust manufacturing and construction activity, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion characterized by GDP growth above $19,000 billion and inflation above 250, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 19000 and CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth above 150,000 thousand persons indicates a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending power and corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment, as indicated by FEDFUNDS below 2.0%, reduces the opportunity cost of holding equities relative to cash, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment, as measured by RSAFS, is a leading indicator of consumer spending and construction activity; higher RSAFS levels consistently correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 260) indicates a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0 and CPIAUCSL < 260.
